milestone_title: Equilibrium Matching, Adaptive Iterative Reasoning, and Hardware-Aware KAN Quantization

task_summary.title: Phase 1: EqM vs PEM on Constraint Graphs
task_summary.key_finding: EqM did NOT outperform PEM. EqM avg_energy=448.68 vs PEM avg_energy=437.45; eqm_satisfaction_rate=0.0 vs pem_satisfaction_rate=0.12; eqm_superior=false over 50 instances.
task_summary.adversarial_flag: NONE — evaluation ran over n=50 instances and produced plausible non-perfect results.

task_summary.title: Phase 2: IRED Adaptive Optimizer
task_summary.key_finding: Adaptive gradient-norm epsilon stopping: 13 steps for simple constraints, 47 steps for hard — shows correct adaptive behaviour.

task_summary.title: Phase 2: IRED Constraint Learning
task_summary.key_finding: IRED trained; final_loss=4.44e-08 (near-zero); output matches target to <0.25% relative error in 1 step.

task_summary.title: Phase 2: IRED SOTA GGUF Integration
task_summary.key_finding: Claimed average_pass_rate=1.0 on both gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF and gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF over 10 problems each.
task_summary.adversarial_flag: IMPLAUSIBLE_PERFECT — pass_rate=1.0 on 10 problems with no model loading preconditions verified. This result requires independent replication before paper citation. Models may not have been locally cached; the artifact lacks preconditions_checked, random_seed, and duration_s fields. Treat as preliminary only.

task_summary.title: Phase 3: CSL IRED Feedback Loop
task_summary.key_finding: Blocked by conductor pre-gate: 1 prior failure (exp2069-fr11-csl-ebrm-feedback) matched task scope with no prior_failures block. Rerun discipline enforced correctly.

task_summary.title: Phase 3: CSL Zero-Forgetting Evaluation / PyPI publish dry-run
task_summary.key_finding: PyPI dry-run passed: sdist=85.2 MB, wheel=4.9 MB, twine_check_passed=true for carnot_ebm-0.1.0b1. Phase 1 ship gate satisfied. No actual publish; operator must tag v0.1.0b1 to trigger workflow.

task_summary.title: Phase 4: ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Quantization
task_summary.key_finding: Artifact contains only asp_kan_ready=true with no supporting schema, methodology, or hardware area numbers. Insufficient for hardware area claims. Not adversarially verified.

task_summary.title: Phase 4: ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Accounting
task_summary.key_finding: Blocked by 16 prior failures matching this scope without prior_failures block. This is the most heavily blocked task in the manifest — 16 consecutive scope-matches. Strict rerun discipline correctly enforced.

task_summary.title: Phase 4: Full E2E Integration Benchmark
task_summary.key_finding: Blocked by 3 prior failures (exp1810, exp1912, exp2092) without prior_failures block. Cascade downstream of exp2105 block.

eqm_analysis.reason: exp2097 shows EqM produces higher energy (worse) and zero constraint satisfaction vs PEM's 12% over 50 instances. EqM as implemented does not improve continuous reasoning on constraint graphs relative to PEM. Root cause unknown — architecture may need energy-landscape redesign or a different objective. This is a research finding, not a fabrication.
eqm_analysis.recommendation: Do not cite EqM as improving continuous reasoning without further architectural iteration. The evaluation result (eqm_superior=false) IS the valid finding and should inform .210+ design.

ired_analysis.sota_integration_recommendation: exp2100 claims 100% pass rate on SOTA GGUFs but lacks preconditions_checked, duration_s, and random_seed. This must be replicated with a PRECONDITIONS block before paper citation. Flag as IMPLAUSIBLE_PERFECT until confirmed.

asp_kan_haq_analysis.reason: exp2104 produced only a one-field artifact (asp_kan_ready=true) with no hardware area numbers, LUT/FF counts, or quantization methodology. exp2105 was blocked for the 16th consecutive run by the failed-experiment rerun discipline. No hardware area reduction was demonstrated this milestone.
asp_kan_haq_analysis.recommendation: Add exp2105 to the exclusion manifest. The ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Accounting scope has a structural problem (no hardware access, toolchain not available, or methodology not viable) that 16 prior failures have not resolved. Retire until operator provides a hardware-accessible environment or revised methodology.

phase1_ship_status.publish_instruction: Tag v0.1.0b1 to trigger `.github/workflows/publish-pypi.yml` actual publish. HuggingFace mirror and IPFS pin still pending for Phase 1 ship completion.

gate_block_summary.primary_cause: Rerun-discipline enforcement: tasks repeated prior-failed scope without prior_failures block.
gate_block_summary.systemic_issue: The ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Accounting scope (exp2105) has been proposed 16 times without root-cause diagnosis. This scope must be retired per the Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline — retire_if_same_verdict was triggered but no exclusion manifest entry was added for it in prior milestones.

operational_findings: EqM implementation is complete but the evaluation result is negative — EqM is strictly worse than PEM on energy and constraint satisfaction at this stage.
IRED optimizer shows valid adaptive behaviour; training converged; SOTA integration result is unverified and should not be cited.
ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Accounting is a permanently stalled scope: 16 block-chain with no root-cause diagnosis. Retire to exclusion manifest.
PyPI dry-run gate passed — Phase 1 ship is ready to trigger once operator tags the release.
Full E2E Integration Benchmark cannot proceed while ASP-KAN-HAQ is in the requires-chain. Either decouple the dependency or fix the upstream first.
next_milestone_priorities: Retire exp2105 scope (ASP-KAN-HAQ Hardware Accounting) to exclusion manifest to stop blocking exp2106.
Redesign EqM energy landscape objective — current approach increases energy vs PEM. Investigate energy-aware composition loss.
Replicate exp2100 IRED SOTA integration with proper PRECONDITIONS block and preconditions_checked artifact fields.
Trigger Phase 1 PyPI publish via tagged release.
Decouple exp2106 Full E2E Integration Benchmark from retired ASP-KAN-HAQ dependency.
